name: Matthew Irwin
story: Matthew Irwin is a Massey University geospatial educator specialising in GIS and remote-sensing software, ArcGIS Server, GPS and UAV technologies. His teaching and technical work connect university training with the practical software, positioning and imagery skills used in professional GIS.
